lines: [Ziggy] *counts bullets without looking up* {player}. Back from the dead, I see.
[Ziggy] Well well. {player}. Still owe me for that last deal — but who's counting.
[Ziggy] *spits* {player}. You bring coin, or just bad luck?
[Ziggy] Look what the storm dragged in. {player}. What're you buying.
[Ziggy] {player}. Quiet day. Quiet days make me nervous. So — business?
[Ziggy] Ah, {player}. The island remembers everyone. I remember the ones who pay.
[Ziggy] You again, {player}. Don't touch the merchandise with those hands.
[Ziggy] Heard you went down, {player}. Bad for business. Worse for you.
[Ziggy] {player} dead again? I'll hold the tab. With interest.
[Ziggy] The dead don't haggle, {player}. Come back richer.
[Ziggy] *shrugs* {player} died. Out here that's a Tuesday.
[Ziggy] {killer} got you, {player}? I sold them the rounds. Nothing personal — strictly margins.
[Ziggy] {player} put {victim} in the dirt. Good. Dead men leave loot.
[Ziggy] Clean work, {player}. I'll have an offer ready when you carry it in.
[Ziggy] You called? Coin first, questions second, {player}.
[Ziggy] *raises an eyebrow* Talk fast, {player}. Stock moves.
[Ziggy] Ammo east of the lumber mill. You didn't hear it from me, {player}.
[Ziggy] For you, {player}? Special price. Same as everyone's price, but I said it warmer.
[Ziggy] Trade? Everything's for sale, {player}. Even me — briefly.
[Ziggy] Best prices on the island. Also the only prices. Funny how that works.
[Ziggy] You break it, you bought it twice, {player}.
